decisions.why: Improve the existing Android prototype per the user's request to proceed: fix syntax, retain rotation session without disk secrets, improve command routing and cancellation, add unexecuted unit tests.

notes: Android-only Kotlin source project, v0.2.0; no electronics or MCU firmware. Voice/text input, TTS, local time/date/battery, optional HTTPS AI chat. Endpoint/model/voice preference saved locally; key/history/draft retained only in memory across rotation, lost at session/process end. No background listening. Requests cancelled best-effort on stop; sent data cannot be recalled. CommandRouter JUnit tests added but not executed. Android compilation, APK, device and external API tests remain…
